One parent path contains unrelated upstream changes relative to the older review basis, so every citation below intentionally names the current immutable parent and final commit.

Normalized executable ASTs, non-docstring runtime strings, non-allowlisted comments, constants, assertions, decorators, executable statements, directive order, and shebang state are unchanged. The ten stable rows are unique, fully cited, and strictly shrink under the ticket's word rule.

Stage 2 — Documentation quality: PASS. Each replacement states the current invariant without retaining bug chronology, repeated setup narration, or decorative framing. The export/import, batching/resume, diagnostic, and scheduling contracts remain explicit.

Stage 3 — Domain integrity: PASS / not applicable. No executable AST, type, identifier, state representation, or domain boundary changed.

Independent validation: 32 focused tests passed in 134.74 seconds. Path-scoped Ruff, Ruff format, comment hygiene, and git diff integrity passed. Full local make verify was intentionally omitted under the documentation-only session direction; Gerrit CI remains the repository-wide gate.
